scope: Proposition 2.2 of the manuscript “Power-law violations of Yau's nodal upper bound” (preprints/Power-law-violations-of-Yaus-nodal-upper-bound-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 350 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b8b6757d7a3a49d7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 4-5. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exist a C1 neighborhood U of the round pair (g−1 0 , 1) among smooth positive pairs, a chart Ω as above, and a number γ > 0 with the following property. Fix a smooth pair (A, ρ) ∈ U, numbers 1 4 ≤ l− < l+ ≤ 1 2 , and suppose that (A, ρ) = (g−1 0 , 1) on {t < l+}. For every integer r ≥ 0 and every η > 0, there exist c > 0 and N0 such that for every integer N ≥ N0, with k as in (2.3), there are a smooth positive pair ( ̂ A, ̂ ρ) ∈ U and a nonzero real smooth function u satisfying: (i) ∥( ̂ A − A, ̂ ρ − ρ)∥Cr < η, and ( ̂ A, ̂ ρ) = (g−1 0 , 1) on {t < l−}; 4 (ii) for ̂ L defined by (2.1), −̂ Lu = k2u, and k2 is a simple eigenvalue of −̂ L on the base B; (iii) u has a sign certificate in Ω of size at least ck1+γ. The neighborhood U, chart Ω, and exponent γ are common to all stages. The constant c and threshold N0 may depend on the fixed input pair, l−, l+, r, η.
